rules.accepted_credit_types: CE meeting Chapter 64B19-13, F.A.C.; medical errors course must be Board-approved
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: those who passed the Florida laws and rules exam are exempt from the 38 h of general, ethics and laws/rules CE but must complete the Board-approved 2-hour medical errors course.
rules.notes: 40 h = 35 general + 2 medical errors + 3 ethics/Florida law (at least 1 h ethics and 1 h laws & rules, Ch. 456, 490, 64B19). Domestic violence every third biennium, inside the 40 h. Report CE in CE Broker; current licenses expire May 31, 2028.
rules.rule_quote: Three (3) of the forty (40) hours must be on professional ethics and Florida Statutes and rules affecting the practice of psychology.
